## Problem

Bug `02c4-4e64-5ee3-459c` proved its AC#2 rests on a false premise: seeding an unconditional
`updated_at` stamp in `clear_absent` cannot drive
`tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py` RED, because `clear_absent`
is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window pass. Both call sites —
`binding_walk.py` ("out-of-window key GET-resolved ALIVE") and
`outbound_mutation_builders.py` (bound-but-absent key whose direct GET returns 200) — gate on
an out-of-window-but-alive key, and the idempotency fixture seeds every key in-window. The
moved absence/tombstone cluster in `binding_lifecycle.py` (`clear_absent`, `note_absent`,
`note_absent_or_rekey` via `binding_store`) therefore has NO integration-tier mutation oracle;
its no-churn/change-gating contract is pinned only at unit tier.

The 02c4 RCA also identified the second blocker: the bound-but-absent direct GET runs through
`run_differs._load_reconcile_backend()` -> `select_backend(compose_config())`, a REAL backend
whose transport 404s for synthetic keys — the harness's fake never receives the GET.

## Context — probe-verified reachability (run in this worktree before planning)

A throwaway probe on the existing harness confirmed the full chain works:
1. Extend the fake with an `out_of_window` key set filtered from `search_issues` results
   (GET still 200s) — models "alive but beyond the search window" (e.g. Done beyond
   `_DONE_RECENT_CAP`).
2. Wire the diff-phase backend to the SAME fake transport: pre-register
   `reconcile_run_differs` (the `lazy_load` cache key `reconcile.py` reuses) and monkeypatch
   its `_load_reconcile_backend` to return `JiraBackend(fake_client)` (the real adapter class
   with the real `.outbound`/`.inbound` mappers — only the transport is faked).
3. Result: pass 2 with `DIG-1` out-of-window reaches `clear_absent("DIG-1")` (spy-counted),
   computes 0 mutations, issues 0 writes, leaves `bindings.json` bytes + tracker HEAD stable
   across a repeated identical pass, and leaves `updated_at` untouched (the change gate).
4. Seeding the 02c4 AC#2 mutation (unconditional `updated_at = _now_iso()` in
   `clear_absent`) flips `updated_at` to the frozen sentinel — the oracle fires.

## Approach — extend `test_reconcile_idempotency.py` (harness + two tests), no src changes

Harness (same file, shared with the existing tests, which stay untouched in behavior):
- `_FakeJiraState.out_of_window: set[str]` and `deleted: set[str]`; `_FakeClient.search_issues`
  filters both; `get_issue_by_rest` raises `urllib.error.HTTPError(404)` for `deleted` keys
  (matching live Jira, which `_safe_get_issue` classifies as `_DELETED`).
- `reconciler_modules` fixture also clears + pre-registers `reconcile_run_differs` so
  `reconcile_once` reuses the test's copy.
- `_run_pass(..., wire_backend=False)`: when True, monkeypatch
  `reconcile_run_differs._load_reconcile_backend` to `lambda: JiraBackend(fake)`.
- A `clear_absent` spy (delegating wrapper on `BindingLifecycle.clear_absent` in the dotted
  `rebar_reconciler.binding_lifecycle` module) counting reached calls.

Test 1 — `test_out_of_window_alive_pass_reaches_clear_absent_with_no_churn`:
pass 1 imports the 3-issue working set; freeze `_now_iso` on BOTH `binding_store` and
`binding_lifecycle` to a 2099 sentinel; mark `DIG-1` out-of-window; pass 2 asserts
(a) `clear_absent` was reached for `DIG-1` (the reach guard 02c4 lacked),
(b) 0 mutations + 0 Jira writes, (c) `DIG-1.updated_at` unchanged from its pass-1 value —
the change-gate oracle: the seeded unconditional stamp turns exactly this RED,
(d) a repeated identical pass 3 keeps `bindings.json` bytes and tracker HEAD stable.

Test 2 — `test_out_of_window_404_then_alive_roundtrip_clears_absence`:
pass 2 with `DIG-1` out-of-window AND deleted -> the direct GET 404s ->
`note_absent`(-or-rekey) records the absence (`absent_404_count` rises, `updated_at` stamps
the frozen lifecycle sentinel — proving the 02c4 clock fix reaches the moved module); pass 3
with `DIG-1` alive again -> `clear_absent` TRUE branch resets the counter to 0. Pins the
tombstone-side sibling and clear_absent's clearing branch at integration tier.

## Scope

- IN: `tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py` only (harness
  extension + the two tests); ticket comments recording the mutation transcript.
- OUT (non-goals): any `src/rebar` change; altering the three existing tests' assertions;
  retirement-at-grace coverage (grace > 1 keeps test 2 away from `retire`); unit-tier changes.
  A behavioral divergence found by the new tests would be filed as a new bug linked
  `discovered_from`, not fixed here.

## Testing (RED -> GREEN mutation protocol)

RED — each mutation seeded, the new tests run, then reverted (`git diff` clean on `src/`):
- Mutant A (the 02c4 AC#2 mutation): `clear_absent` stamps `updated_at` unconditionally ->
  test 1's updated_at assertion FAILS (probe-verified: sentinel appears).
- Mutant B (reach regression): drop the `clear_absent` best-effort call in
  `outbound_mutation_builders.py` -> test 1's spy-count assertion FAILS.
- Mutant C: `clear_absent` no longer resets the counter -> test 2's counter-reset assertion
  FAILS.

GREEN — unmutated: the WHOLE `test_reconcile_idempotency.py` file passes (3 existing + 2 new).
Gates: `make lint`, `make typecheck`, `python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check`
(new=0 increased=0). No `src/rebar` file modified.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] An integration test drives an out-of-window-but-alive key through the real reconcile
      pass to `clear_absent` (spy-verified reach), asserting no mutations, no Jira writes, an
      untouched `updated_at`, and byte/HEAD stability across a repeated pass
      (`pytest tests/integration/rebar_reconciler/test_reconcile_idempotency.py -q`).
- [x] Seeding the 02c4 AC#2 mutation (unconditional `updated_at` stamp in `clear_absent`)
      drives that test RED — verified by running it, transcript recorded as a ticket comment.
- [x] A second integration test pins the 404 -> alive round-trip: `note_absent` records the
      absence with the frozen lifecycle clock's sentinel, and `clear_absent`'s clearing branch
      resets the counter — the moved cluster's siblings exercised at integration tier.
- [x] Mutants B and C (reach regression; no-reset regression) each turn their assertion RED,
      transcripts recorded, all mutations reverted.
- [x] The three pre-existing tests in the file still pass unmodified.
- [x] `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the complexity ratchet pass; no `src/rebar` file is
      modified by this change.
